name: Duskwood restored quests: the map marks each objective area and the turn-in
contract: The thirteen Duskwood quests of rev_20261011_95_coa_duskwood_restore.sql (254086-254089, 254091, 255067-255074) had no quest_poi rows, so the world map drew nothing for them. This case sends the CMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY a real client sends for each quest in the log and reads SMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY_RESPONSE: every quest must answer with one marker per objective area, on the Duskwood map (WorldMapAreaId 34), followed by the turn-in pin (ObjectiveIndex -1) on its ender. A control query for 17003, which the character does not carry, must come back empty.
